fact: From 26 October 2026 a national mission is inventorying the IT equipment of territorial administrations including mairies in Haut-Ogooué, as phase 2 of a national diagnostic after phase 1 in the nine provincial capitals (22 April to 6 May 2026), to plan investment.
title: Gabon: Digitalisation des collectivités locales - Le Haut-Ogooué, première étape de l'inventaire national du parc informatique
